item.title: UP POCSO Court Awards Death Penalty to Couple for Decade-Long Abuse of 33 Children
item.description: GUWAHATI: A special POCSO court in Banda, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday sentenced a former government junior engineer and his wife to death for sexually abusing 33 boys over a period of nearly ten years and distributing videos and images of the assaults on the dark web to buyers in dozens of countries.
